com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Create a named CSV export template using supported source fields and your chosen column headings and order. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes.
examples: Preview creating a template named Fictional Practice CSV with these ordered source fields and headers: vendor as Supplier, invoice_number as Invoice, total as Total, currency as Currency. Wait for my confirmation.

description: Apply only the exact change returned by preview_create_export_template, after the user confirms that preview. Accepts its confirmation_token only; changed or expired records require a new preview. Prepare a named CSV column template using supported source fields. Requires confirmation and accounting-setup permission.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by this operation’s preview, after the user confirms its displayed changes.
confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token

name: create_export_template
title: Create a CSV template
